In App info, tap ⋮ at the top right, then Allow restricted settings, and verify.

No ⋮ menu or no Allow option? Your device may not need this step, or the option only appears after you try to turn on accessibility once. Tap Done and go to step 2. If a \"Restricted setting\" dialog appears, come back here.

1) Tap Open App info.
2) Tap ⋮ at the top right.
3) Tap Allow restricted settings and verify with your fingerprint or PIN.
4) Come back to this screen and tap Done.
Why: On Android 13 and later, apps installed from outside an app store are blocked from sensitive permissions such as accessibility until you allow them. This step lifts that block.
Go to Accessibility > Installed apps and turn on ShieldTap.
If a \"Restricted setting\" dialog appears, go back to step 1 and allow it.
3. Add the widget to your home screen
Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, tap Widgets, and pick ShieldTap.
This home screen doesn\'t support adding widgets directly. Add it manually as shown below.
This only opens the Auto Blocker settings screen and doesn\'t touch the switch. When the screen opens, tap Back.
Tap the widget to switch between On and Off.

1) Tap Open Accessibility settings.
2) Under Installed apps (or Downloaded apps), select ShieldTap.
3) Turn on the switch and tap Allow.
4) If a "Restricted setting" dialog appears, go back to step 1 and allow it.
Why: ShieldTap needs accessibility access to tap the switch on the Auto Blocker screen for you. It only looks at that one screen.

1) Tap Add widget to home screen.\n2) Tap Add in the dialog that appears.\nIf there\'s no button or no dialog, touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, tap Widgets > ShieldTap, and place it as 2x1.
Why: You turn Auto Blocker on and off by tapping the widget.
1) Tap Read state to open the Auto Blocker screen.\n2) Don\'t touch the switch. Just tap Back.\n3) When you return here, the step changes to ✓.
Why: The widget needs to learn once whether Auto Blocker is currently on or off.
Turn Scan apps with Play Protect back on. You only need it off while installing.
Can\'t open Play Protect settings. Turn it on in Play Store > profile > Play Protect.
Opens the Auto Blocker screen, turns the switch on, and returns to the home screen.
Recommended: turn back on after 30 minutes

On the Auto Blocker screen, turn on \"Turn on Auto Blocker automatically\" (One UI 8.5 and later). If you turn Auto Blocker off with the widget and forget, it comes back on after 30 minutes. The option may be near the bottom of the screen.

Turn the two things you switched off for installing back on. Your device is safer with them on. ShieldTap still lets you turn Auto Blocker off and on from the widget. With \"Turn on Auto Blocker automatically\" on, it\'s safe even if you forget to turn it back on.

1) Tap Check for updates to open the latest release page.
2) If the top version is newer than the version at the bottom of this screen, tap shieldtap-v<version>.apk to download it.
3) Turn off Scan apps with Play Protect for a moment and install it over the current app. Your settings and widget stay as they are.
For automatic update checks, add this repository to the Obtainium app.
